title: Coast Guard conducts K9 hoist training in Galveston, Texas
description: U.S. Coast Guard K9 Simba from Maritime Safety and Security Team Houston, conducts a hoist in Galveston, Texas, June 18, 2022. These practice hoists are done to prepare the K9 and their handler for rapid deployments to vessels out on the water. (U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 3rd Class Alejandro Rivera)
